1704-2757-5362-7063.notablePrerequisites: This combo has a chance of failure based on the amount of starting mana you have and your first few coin flips. It may take significantly more or less mana than the amount shown. See the widget below for calculations.
1704-2757-5362-7063.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an untapped creature you control, untapping a basic land.
Activate that basic land by tapping it, adding one mana.
Repeat until there are no more available creatures to tap.
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, targeting Krark.
When you cast Quantum Misalignment, Krark and any additional copies of Krark trigger.
Resolve all Krark triggers, copying Quantum Misalignment for each flip you won, and returning the original to your hand as long as you lost at least one flip.
Resolve each copy of Quantum Misalignment, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Krark each time.
If Quantum Misalignment is back in your hand, repeat from step 1.
If you won every flip, instead resolve the Quantum Misalignment card itself, creating one more Krark token and putting the card into your graveyard.
Repeat steps 1 through 9 with Ember Island Production, if you still need more Krark copies.
If you manage to pass a critical threshold of Krark copies before both Quantum Misalignment and Ember Island Production end up in your graveyard, this combo is overwhelmingly likely to be an infinite loop from that point on. See the widget below for failure chances.
Once you have infinite mana and infinite copies of Krark, you can repeat this loop with any instant or sorcery you can cast.

574-856-4321-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
574-856-4321-8347.description:

Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat
574-856-4321-8347.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

3968-4050-4078-4699.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
3968-4050-4078-4699.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.

When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Overgrowth Elemental triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.

Resolve the Yahenni ability.

2738-4556-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Blight Mound, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2713-4067-7890.description:

2021-2060-2445-7061.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

215-4188-7730.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
215-4188-7730.description:

When Body Double enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Body Double from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Woe Strider ability.

When the land dies, Anax and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a creature token.

Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.

1429-5402-5929-6798.description:

When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.

Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.

1987-2187-4276-5913.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2187-4276-5913.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Pinnacle Monk and Possessed Skaab.
When Pinnacle Monk and Possessed Skaab enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2187-4276-5913.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

372-1922-2493.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Blur exiled by Abdel Adrian.

Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Archaeomancer and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Archaeomancer trigger.

Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Archaeomancer and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.
